Declaration: FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed by VAR sections; omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Need include input/output vars. Implementation ST body. supporting_objects list helper DUT/POU. Need define referenced DUTs. We likely don't need DUTs except maybe mode enum? Interface uses INT, no enum required. Could define constants? Supporting objects maybe empty list. Need ensure compilation valid. Need implement restartable 30-second delay using IEC timer TON or time arithmetic. Need scan semantics: first invocation starts timer at elapsed zero; dt_ms elapsed since preceding invocation. In CODESYS FB, no dt_ms input in interface! Wait interface only has OCCUPANCY_DETECTED, ENERGY_SAVING_MODE, HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR, outputs. But requirements mention dt_ms is elapsed time since preceding invocation; tests provide dt_ms. How can FB know dt_ms? Standard CODESYS has no implicit cycle time. This is tricky. We need implement timer using TON? TON uses internal time and current scan; but offline simulation tests likely set dt? In real CODESYS, TON uses task cycle time; but tests supply dt_ms. Need function block interface preserved exactly; cannot add input dt_ms. But can perhaps use standard timer TON with PT#30S and call it; in simulation test harness may manipulate? But offline compile maybe not run. However tests expected precise dt_ms. Could use TON; CODESYS TON uses system time. But cannot match explicit dt_ms unless harness uses cycle times. The spec says "dt_ms is elapsed time since preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed..." It seems expected implementation might use TON and test harness supplies dt via simulation? But no dt input. Hmm.

Need produce likely expected CODESYS code. Typically for these tasks, implement timer with TON and call with PT:=T#30S; IN:=permit. This satisfies behavior in real runtime. But test steps have dt_ms; they might use simulator that advances time between calls. We cannot control. They may expect use TON. Need decide.

Can use `TON` standard library. Declaration: VAR
 OCCUPANCY_DETECTED: BOOL;
 ENERGY_SAVING_MODE: BOOL;
 HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR: INT;
 SUPPLY_FAN_RUN: BOOL;
 TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST: INT;
END_VAR
VAR
 fbDelay: TON;
END_VAR

Implementation:
fbDelay(IN := OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3, PT := T#30S);
SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := fbDelay.Q;

Calculate temp:
IF HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 3 THEN
 TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;
ELSIF OCCUPANCY_DETECTED THEN
 TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;
ELSE
 CASE HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR OF
  0: IF ENERGY_SAVING_MODE THEN TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 3; ELSE 2; END_IF;
  1: TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 1;
  2: TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;
 ELSE
  TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;
 END_CASE;
END_IF;
Clamp to ±4 maybe already but include.

Need "Initialize outputs to OFF and zero at power-up; update them from current inputs when normal calculation begins." In ST, FB variables initialized by declaration? We can initialize outputs in VAR? In CODESYS declaration can `SUPPLY_FAN_RUN : BOOL := FALSE; TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST : INT := 0;` But interface exact types; can include init. However outputs are assigned each call anyway. Need first call immediate adjust. TON first call with dt zero? If first call permit true, fbDelay.Q false. If first call not permit resets. Good.

Potential issue TON IN resets when false; Q false, ET zero. Good.

Need maybe use `fbDelay(IN := (OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND (HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3)), PT := T#30S);` then `SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := fbDelay.Q;`. For night immediate off because IN false. If occupancy lost immediate.

Need declaration exact. The output variables should be under VAR_OUTPUT, inputs under VAR_INPUT. Need function block declaration only, no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Include `VAR` for fbDelay. We can include initialization. In CODESYS declaration:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
  OCCUPANCY_DETECTED : BOOL;
  ENERGY_SAVING_MODE : BOOL;
  HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR : INT;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
  SUPPLY_FAN_RUN : BOOL := FALSE;
  TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST : INT := 0;
END_VAR
VAR
  fbFanDelay : TON;
END_VAR
No END_FUNCTION_BLOCK.

Supporting_objects: [] maybe. But they ask "Define referenced DUTs." No DUT referenced. TON standard library. Could include no helpers. Need `supporting_objects` list empty.

Need ensure JSON valid. Implementation string with newlines. Could include escaped newlines. Return only JSON no markdown.

But let's think about potential hidden requirements: They may expect exact mode table. Need check T1 step 6: occupancy true mode 3 expected adjust 4 fan false. Our code: night -> 4, TON IN false -> Q false. Good. T1 step 7 occ true mode 2 after previous night: TON IN true, but timer starts at first non-night occupied call. dt 100, Q false for 30s. Expected fan false. Good.

T2 delay: Step1 first permit true dt 0, TON starts at 0 Q false. Step2 dt 29900 -> elapsed 29.9 Q false. Step3 dt100 -> elapsed 30.0 Q true. CODESYS TON Q becomes true when ET >= PT. Good. Step4 occupancy false -> IN false, Q false immediate, ET resets. Step5 permit true -> starts new. Step6 29.9 false. Step7 +100 true. Step8 night -> IN false Q false. Good.

Need maybe if mode invalid? not required. Could default 0. Good.

Could include clamping:
IF TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST > 4 THEN TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4; ELSIF TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST < -4 THEN TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := -4; END_IF;
Not necessary but ensures bounded. Need initialize outputs? yes.

Potential issue in declaration: In CODESYS, initialization of VAR_OUTPUT may not be allowed? It is allowed. But if exact interface, initialization okay? Maybe. To be safe, don't initialize in declaration? Requirement initialize at power-up. In ST, FB vars initialize to 0/FALSE by default. So no need explicit. But "Initialize outputs to OFF and zero at power-up" default handles. Could include explicit to be clear. But exact interface names/types unaffected. I'll include `:= FALSE` and `:= 0` maybe okay. However some parsing may expect exact? It says keep exact task interface names/types. Init doesn't change type. Fine.

Need maybe use `TON` requires `TON` from `Standard`. Available.

Need if implementation body alone, no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Good.

Should supporting_objects be list of helper DUT/POU; empty acceptable? It says "supporting_objects is a list of helper DUT/POU objects, each with..." If none, [].

Could define a DUT for mode constants? Not referenced. Avoid.

Need final JSON only. Ensure valid escaping. Use double quotes. Implementation string can contain actual newline? JSON strings cannot contain unescaped newline. Need use \n. Return JSON object.

{
 "declaration": "FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task\nVAR_INPUT\n  OCCUPANCY_DETECTED : BOOL;\n  ENERGY_SAVING_MODE : BOOL;\n  HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR : INT;\nEND_VAR\nVAR_OUTPUT\n  SUPPLY_FAN_RUN : BOOL := FALSE;\n  TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST : INT := 0;\nEND_VAR\nVAR\n  fbFanDelay : TON;\nEND_VAR",
 "implementation": "fbFanDelay(IN := OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND (HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3), PT := T#30S);\nSUPPLY_FAN_RUN := fbFanDelay.Q;\n\nIF HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 3 THEN\n    TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;\nELSIF OCCUPANCY_DETECTED THEN\n    TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;\nELSE\n    CASE HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR OF\n        0:\n            IF ENERGY_SAVING_MODE THEN\n                TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 3;\n            ELSE\n                TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 2;\n            END_IF;\n        1:\n            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 1;\n        2:\n            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;\n    ELSE\n        TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;\n    END_CASE;\nEND_IF;\n\nIF TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST > 4 THEN\n    TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;\nELSIF TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST < -4 THEN\n    TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := -4;\nEND_IF;",
 "supporting_objects": []
}

Need check CODESYS CASE syntax: In ST, CASE label syntax:
CASE HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR OF
0:
    ...
1:
    ...
2:
    ...
ELSE
    ...
END_CASE;
Yes. But after `0:` statements need semicolon. Good. There is a potential issue: `ELSE` in CASE with no semicolon? fine.

One subtlety: CODESYS TON uses IN boolean expression. Good.

But let's think if there is a hidden expectation to handle `dt_ms` explicitly without input. Maybe some tasks from this dataset expect using `TON` and test harness uses simulated time? The interface cannot include dt. Could maybe use `SysTime` or `RTC` but not in offline compile? Standard library. But TON is correct.

Could there be need for `VAR RETAIN`? no.

Need "declaration is CODESYS FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed by all VAR sections; omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK." Our declaration has no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Good.

Need "implementation is the ST body alone." good.

Need "supporting_objects is a list of helper DUT/POU objects, each with name, kind (DUT/FUNCTION/FUNCTION_BLOCK), declaration, implementation; functions need return_type." Empty okay.

Let's final.
